# Graham

Graham is Daniel Graham's line at AgentHive Inc, Palm Coast.

Unknown callers hit Graham. A number on the contacts list still rings the cell. A mill script is blocked. A country code is not a reason.

Graham books a weekday hold, takes the note, and alerts Daniel when the work has stopped. The body double speaks the answer and cuts a caption reel. It introduces itself. It does not pretend to be a filmed face.

The standup is the same being under the client's surname. The template is a recipe: skills and routines, no contacts, no keys. Price: $1,750 setup (50% to start or pay in full), then $250/mo.
